candidats.description: Ed 'Big Daddy' Roth was an artist, cartoonist, illustrator, pinstriper and custom car designer and builder who created the hot-rod icon Rat Fink and other characters. Roth was a key figure in Southern California's Kustom Kulture and hot-rod movement of the late 1950s and 1960s. Tweedy Pie was originally built by Bob Johnston in 1955. This 1920 Ford T-bucket was widened 3 inches and channeled over bobbed Deuce rails. Ed Roth striped the car for Bob. candidats.description: Gonaives, Haiti (Mar. 10, 2005) - Builder Constructionman Will Robinson assigned to Naval Mobile Construction Battalion One (NMCB-1), prepares to load a bucket of clean sand into a cement mixer in Gonaives, Haiti. Robinson and his fellow Seabees are constructing a new school near the site of the existing school. NMCB-1 is part of the New Horizon Task Force, which is deployed to Haiti for three months to conduct humanitarian construction and medical assistance. candidats.titre: File:U.S. Navy Chief Builder Courtland Sawyer fills a bucket with rocks during construction of a footbridge March 27, 2013, in Zambales, Philippines 130327-M-KF455-058.jpg
candidats.description: U.S. Navy Chief Builder Courtland Sawyer fills a bucket with rocks during construction of a footbridge March 27, 2013, in Zambales, Philippines. The project was one of eight engineering civic action programs missions being performed by Joint Civil Military Operations Task Force units in support of exercise Balikatan 2013. Balikatan is an annual bilateral training exercise designed to increase interoperability between the Armed Forces of the Philippines and the U.S. military when responding to future natural disasters.
